model.name: Inter-organizational Relationship
model.purpose: Describe attributed, time-qualified organizational relationships without confusing affiliation, supply, consolidation and ownership.
model.scope_statement: A source-qualified relationship aggregate with explicit participants, kind, direction, scope and evidence. Real-world relation state, publisher record state and observer claims remain separate. Multi-party arrangements require retained membership context.
in_scope: Relationship identity, endpoint roles and qualified kind
Control-basis references, collaboration and exchange scope
Temporal assertions, graph constraints, disputes and permitted mappings
out_of_scope: Organization identity, contract execution and ownership-register mastership
Inferring legal authority, beneficial ownership or universal transitivity from a generic link

boundary_notes.distinction: Reference organization identities; a relationship is not either organization.
Customer/account and supplier/partner qualification remain separate lifecycle masters; relationships provide scoped links.
Qualified relation kinds are not universally equivalent; person beneficial owners are out of endpoint scope.
PROV Association qualifies activity-agent provenance, not inter-organizational partnership; contract execution stays delegated.

functions.name: Resolve qualified relationship
functions.description: Compare identities and scopes without merging parallel relations.
effects: Read-only; identity ambiguity returns candidates, never automatic same-as

functions.name: Inspect qualified graph
functions.description: Traverse asserted or explicitly derived relationships at a declared time.
preconditions: Authorized endpoints and reviewed kind-specific graph rules
effects: Read-only; unsupported transitivity or cycles yield warnings/rejection

functions.name: Record attributed assertion
functions.description: Append evidence-backed claim without creating a real-world agreement.
outputs: New immutable local assertion or conflict report
effects: Local append only; no signatures, payments or grants; failed checks leave head unchanged

functions.name: Append lifecycle revision
functions.description: Separate effective termination, correction and record retirement.
effects: Append with compensating revision for mistakes; never erase provenance or terminate a contract

functions.name: Register counterclaim
functions.description: Preserve incompatible positions for authorized review.
outputs: Attributed contested set and review status
preconditions: No automated truth ranking by recency alone
effects: Append dispute; no endpoint coercion or automatic adverse decision

functions.name: Export permitted projection
functions.description: Apply versioned vocabulary mapping with declared losses.
outputs: Projection and loss report or refusal
effects: Export only scoped data; unsupported arity/meaning produces refusal; publication needs explicit authority

composition.purpose: Proposed endpoint-identity reference, not a frozen approved ledger edge.
Proposed customer/account lifecycle delegation where relevant.
Proposed supplier qualification delegation where relevant.
Candidate generic links; relationship kind semantics require a profile.
Candidate organization-interest subset only, with explicit endpoint and component loss.

owner_package_requirements: Declare the relationship-data owner and steward.
Identify organization, contract, ownership and commercial masters.
Bind delegation, access, dispute and retention policies before writes.
dimension.namespace_guidance: Use a master-qualified relationship ID distinct from its endpoint tuple, type, direction and revisions; never merge parallel scopes by names.

canonicalization_rules: Preserve source definition, endpoint roles, scope and valid interval.
No default equivalence of consolidation, equity, votes, affiliation or supply; no default graph closure.
patch_rules: Use namespaced extensions pinned to the base digest with pre/post validation.
Append corrections under expected-head check, retaining evidence and counterclaims.
compatibility_rules: Kind, direction, arity or control-basis changes require explicit migration and loss report.
Do not coerce date-only effective values into invented precise timestamps.

artifact_rules.timestamp_rule: RFC 3339 with seconds and explicit offset or Z for precise recording/observation instants; retain date-only effective precision separately.
artifact_rules.serial_naming_rule: Relationship artifact-kind prefix, escaped stable identifier and immutable revision; time is optional display metadata.
artifact_rules.integrity_rule: Verify exact-byte digests and revision references; hashes prove neither truth nor commercial authority.

policies: Relationship assertion does not authorize transactions, contract signatures or legal control decisions.
Do not infer missing, withheld or unreported relationships as proven non-existence.
Only kind-specific reviewed graph rules may derive links; retain inputs and time slice.
Conflicting attributed assertions coexist until an authorized resolution.

read: Read Dimension policy, kind definition, endpoint roles, source scope, time and assurance before using a relationship.
create: Create only an authorized attributed assertion; preserve uncertain participant identity and require a distinct relationship ID.
update: Append with expected-head and kind-specific graph checks; keep real-world change separate from record correction.
delete: Apply retention/legal-hold policy and authorized tombstones; never terminate contracts or delete endpoint organizations as a side effect.

roles.name: Relationship steward
responsibilities: Owns kind, endpoint and scope interpretation.

roles.name: Assertion contributor
responsibilities: Adds attributable claims within authorized scope.

roles.name: Reviewer
responsibilities: Assesses conflicting evidence and proposed graph mappings.

access.default_rule: Deny unless the owning Dimension grants purpose-specific access.
exceptions: Explicit recorded, time-limited delegation only; public endpoint names do not make private relationship evidence public.
audit_requirements: Record actor, scope, source revision, conflict decision and disclosure without tokens or private source copies.

read_order: Dimension identity, delegation and access policy
Pinned relationship model and kind profile
Endpoint/master references, effective time and evidence
Safe append, dispute, mapping, extension and retirement checks

coverage.claim: Bounded source-grounded proposed relationship context contract; not universal legal semantics or executed adapter conformance.

checklist.notes: Qualified ID and parallel relationship scope.
Versioned kind, exclusions and control basis.
Direction, roles, arity, scope and qualified interest.
Attributed evidence and misleading shared-name/address signals.
Six proposed relationship-record operations, not real-world commercial authority.
Real-world state versus publisher retirement and corrections.
Effective interval, precision, observation and recording.
Assertion source and graph derivation are explicit.
Relationship-data steward distinct from endpoint or equity owner.
Relational object; physical endpoint properties remain delegated.
External attempts timed out; nested schemas and round-trip fixtures are not implemented.
Question/answer traceability and profile checks are specified; executable nested schemas and round-trip/graph fixtures are deferred.

known_omissions: Claude and Grok each timed out on the sole bounded attempt; Codex-only reviewable-draft, no independent corroboration.
Selected clauses only; exact dated source pins, source licenses and complete normative applicability remain to be verified.
Full RR-CDF XSD fields, BODS/OCDS constraints and real round-trip fixtures have not been validated.
No executable nested answer schema, identity resolver, graph rule engine or commercial operation is delivered.
Jurisdiction-specific partnership, control, reporting-exception and disclosure law remain adopter-owned profile work.
Multi-party and cyclic graph fixtures, relation-ledger approval and independent review remain open.
regional_assumptions: Generic relationship is not a universal legal category. Accounting consolidation and beneficial ownership must retain their source definitions and jurisdictions.
adversarial_checks: Reject shared branding as legal control.
Reject publisher record closure as real-world termination.
Reject absence or non-disclosure as a negative fact.
Reject pairwise flattening of multi-party arrangements without loss.
Reject PROV activity association as equivalent to partnership.
Reject scope-free percentages or indirect graph-derived ownership.
Reject local record update as power to bind an organization.
